title: Thai Financial Domain Adaptation of THaLLE -- Technical Report

task.subset_rule: all 50 questions of the SET public IC practice exam P1
task.approximation: the Thai exam PDF must be converted to text; the answer is extracted after the prompt's own marker (resolution plan); decoding parameters not stated

items.source: https://media.set.or.th/set/Documents/2022/Apr/Practice_Plain_Question_Answer.pdf (SET public IC practice exam P1 with answer key; ref. [24]; 0.6 MB)
items.license: SET public practice material (terms of use not checked)

fields_prose.input: question text and the four numbered options
fields_prose.label: answer key digit 1-4

items.pdf_text_layer_check: downloaded 2026-09-07 (22 pages, 0.6 MB): PyMuPDF text extraction loses Thai tone marks (U+0E48/U+0E49, e.g. 'ทีสุด' for 'ที่สุด') and maps digits of one embedded font to letters/symbols (question numbers '3.'/'4.' appear as 'B.'/'F.', answer-key lines read 'ตัวเลือกที ?' or 'ตัวเลือกที  '); the answer key is therefore not machine-readable from the text layer

prompt.system:
You are a Certified Thai Investment Consultant (IC) taking a multiple choice exam.
Think step-by-step and then finish your answer with " ดังนั้น คำตอบที่ถูกต้องคือ: " followed by the correct choice name (1, 2, 3, or 4).
prompt.source_location: Appendix B, Table 4 (CoT system prompt) and Appendix C, Table 5 (user-prompt layout: 'Question:' plus options '1)'-'4)')
prompt.verbatim: full for the system prompt (extraction damage repaired: '/uni0E49.low' glyph codes restored to the Thai tone mark U+0E49, 'm ultiple' re-joined); user layout copied from the Appendix C example

output.parse: regex คำตอบที่ถูกต้องคือ\s*:?\s*\**\s*([1-4])
output.postprocess: strip; no digit found counts as incorrect
output.parse_prose: regex 'คำตอบที่ถูกต้องคือ\s*:?\s*\**\s*([1-4])' (last match); fallback: last standalone digit 1-4 in the reply

metric.name: accuracy
metric.definition: fraction of the 50 P1 questions whose extracted choice equals the answer key
metric.original_location: Table 3, row gpt-4-turbo-2024-04-09, column P1 (P2 68%, P3 84%)

open_points: no hook: the 50 items exist only inside the SET practice-exam PDF whose text layer is damaged (Thai tone marks dropped, answer-key digits garbled - see items.pdf_text_layer_check); OCR or manual transcription into items.inline (number, question, option_1..option_4, answer) with a check against the rendered PDF is required; no PDF/OCR tooling within stdlib+numpy.

once items.inline exists: set items.source_type = in_paper; placeholders, the regex parse (a hook should take the LAST marker match; the runner takes the first) and accuracy are already in machine form.
notes: Which system prompt produced Table 3 follows from Appendix C (CoT prompt shown with gpt-4-turbo-2024-04-09 output). The PDF text layer must be checked for Thai extraction errors; P2 (25) and P3 (25) use the same layout.
runner_gaps: items: no PDF source (needs a transcribed table)
